name: The Real Estate Agent OS
tagline: Your complete real estate business command center
description: A powerful real estate business management system for agents to track listings, leads, showings, transactions, and commissions.
benefits: Streamline your entire real estate workflow from lead capture to closing
Never lose track of a lead, listing, or showing with centralized tracking
Close more deals with organized transaction pipelines and deadline management
Maximize earnings with transparent commission tracking and split calculations
Save 5+ hours weekly with automated status updates and pre-built templates
whats_included: 5 fully interconnected databases with custom properties
Property listing management with status tracking
Lead capture system with scoring and nurture workflows
Showing scheduler with feedback collection forms
Transaction pipeline from offer to close with milestones
Commission calculator with broker split percentages
4 bonus templates for client meetings and open houses
perfect_for: New real estate agents building their first business systems
Experienced agents scaling to handle higher transaction volume
Real estate team leaders managing multiple agents' deals
Independent brokers running their own practice without a CRM
features: Drag-and-drop kanban boards for visual deal pipeline management
Automated status propagation across all linked databases
Calendar views for showings, deadlines, and follow-ups
Built-in commission calculator with custom split percentages
Lead scoring system to prioritize high-value prospects
Property comparison templates for buyer presentations
Client communication log with timestamped notes
Mobile-optimized layouts for field access on any device

linked_databases.description: Connect each transaction to its corresponding property listing
Link buyers and sellers to their closed deals
Associate each showing with the property shown
Track which lead attended each showing
Automatically generate commission records from closed transactions
Connect seller leads to their listed properties

bonus_templates.description: Complete preparation and follow-up checklist for successful open houses

bonus_templates.name: Buyer Consultation Questionnaire
bonus_templates.description: Comprehensive intake form to understand buyer needs, budget, and timeline

bonus_templates.name: Seller Listing Presentation Outline
bonus_templates.description: Structured template for delivering compelling listing presentations

bonus_templates.name: Weekly Business Review Template
bonus_templates.description: Reflective framework to track KPIs, wins, and action items each week

views: Follow-up Queue (Calendar View by Next Contact Date)
